approved_definition_context: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space, with Borel measurable structure and canonical Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. alpha,beta are nonnegative reals (NNReal). Every binder/let is part of the exact theorem contract.

ContDiff R 2 means twice continuously differentiable. fderiv R is the actual Frechet derivative; nested fderiv applied twice gives the true Hessian bilinear evaluation. inner R and norm are the real Hilbert inner product and norm.

mu.tilted f is the measure with density exp(f)/integral exp(f) relative to mu. The exponential normalization is a real Bochner integral; in degenerate cases the operation is still defined. No probability or nonzero normalization certificate is built into this definition.

MemLp id 2 mu means identity is measurable modulo mu and has finite second moment. covarianceBilin mu v w is the true covariance of scalar projections inner(v,X),inner(w,X) under mu when id is L2. IsProbabilityMeasure is probability. All integrals displayed are genuine Bochner integrals; volume is canonical Lebesgue volume.
